Package com.neueda.leap.order.model

Class Instrument

java.lang.Object
com.neueda.leap.order.model.Instrument
@Entity public class Instrument extends Object
Instrument entity representing a tradeable security. Supports COMMON_STOCK, FX, and CRYPTO asset classes.
